facts.text: Under the Sewanee Pledge, students who do not graduate in four consecutive years are provided up to one additional year of study tuition-free.

sources.title: The Sewanee Pledge | The University of the South | Sewanee
sources.quote: We pledge—that you will graduate in four consecutive years (with one major). If you do not, Sewanee will provide up to one additional year of study tuition-free.

facts.text: Sewanee students are provided funding for a summer internship or research fellowship and a semester-long study-abroad opportunity at no additional tuition cost.

sources.title: The Sewanee Pledge | The University of the South | Sewanee
sources.quote: Sewanee students are provided funding for a summer internship or research fellowship, a semester-long study-abroad opportunity at no additional tuition cost, and the ability to graduate with one major in four years.
